notes.title: Blood West v4.5
notes.content:
Hey there, Gunslingers - we got another update for ya today. And this one's a [b]doozy.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/ad83535540f368f7f959c3cc4d737028665d714a.png[/img]

First and foremost, as you may know, Blood West comes to you [b]from Poland with Love[/b] and as such it's part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/frompolandwithlove2025]From Poland with Love sale[/url] on Steam right now!

So we went ahead and made a new trailer for ya:

[previewyoutube=G4jukdHAiNU;full][/previewyoutube]
And no you're not hearing things, there's now [b]MORE[/b] voice lines in Blood West than ever before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/36151eddb517c222889425feb74f6ee2c0700df8.png[/img]
We've had over [b]50 new voice lines[/b] recorded by the legendary Stephen Russell as The Undead Gunslinger woven into the main campaign of Blood West to expand on both the lore of the land and his personal backstory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/24dd5b18950b39d680eab61ff146b5c947457d56.png[/img]
[i]Enjoy.[/i]

We've also added a [b]LONG[/b] requested localization, [b]Full PT-BR language support![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/04c570e9f327d1fca21099d5ce11227e3ef26493.jpg[/img]
[i]You're welcome.[/i]

Now... last December we released the expansion - [i]Blood West: Dead Man's Promise[/i] - and while y'all have certainly taken a liking to the adventure of Twen's father - [b]The Shaman[/b] - it seems we may have [i]over shot[/i] the price of this DLC a little bit. [b]So we're dropping the price... permanently![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158590/Blood_West_Dead_Mans_Promise/
[quote][b]Blood West: Dead Man's Promise will now cost only $9.99 USD.[/b] And if you ever paid more than $9.99 please send an email with proof of purchase to admin@NewBlood.games and we'll either give you a key for one of our other games or refund you the difference. [i]Because We Love You and We Hate Money[/i] <3[/quote]
But wait, there's more!

You've been asking for the incredible Blood West loading screen art to be sold as art prints, so now for the first time ever they're available [url=https://newbloodstore.com/]on the New Blood Store![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/e85523aa42650b9862db92f656891395c85e00ba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/39363a3bd0e6ba9c0591761c137e613a3698ef5d.png[/img]

And last but certainly not least - we can finally announce that [b]The Blood West Original Soundtrack will be releasing on Steam and all digital storefronts on September 23rd![/b]

[previewyoutube=XF9zNpFcjwo;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Yee haw.[/i]

If you appreciate the work we do don't forget to leave a review and spread the good word of Hyperstrange and New Blood ːleatherneckː

[b]TL:DR[/b]

[list]
[*] New trailer
[*] PT-BR Language added
[*] New voice lines from Stephen Russell
[*] Dead Man's Promise price drop
[*] Art prints for sale
[*] Sountrack releases September 23rd!
[/list]
[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] More Voice Overs from Stephen Russell! - just like in Dead Man’s Promise (with the amazing Redd Pepper) the protagonist will comment on visited areas all around the map. 
[*] Added Brazilian Portuguese - thanks to Gabriel Finotti, Blood West can now be experienced in another language. 
[*] Improvements to Cleansing Fire quest to make it a bit more intuitive (it’s enough to set skeletons on fire to progress)
[*] Slight optimization for some edge cases. This could be observed mostly when killing lots and lots of enemies without resting or dying. And in Chapter 3 in certain areas.
[*] Saving mid-dialogue is no longer possible to avoid potential issues.
[*] Added small bits of SFX to certain objects that were missing them
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a possible crash if player tried loading a save game where they declined the NG+ option
[*] Fixed an issue with flammable ammo not working correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where Molotovs wouldn’t be available at shops
[*] Fixed a bug in which summons didn’t work correctly in Dead Man’s Promise NG+
[*] Fixed a bug in which Golden Cigar would not appear in player’s inventory after starting NG+ if their inventory was full
[*] Fixed a bug where Cactus Bota wouldn’t prolong effects of alcohol. Also the item now mentions the duration in description properly.
[*] Fixed another bug where maxed out Alcohol Tolerance perk wasn’t prolonging effects of alcohol for the correct amount of time
[*] Fixed a bug with Depth Hunter’s ragdolls that could cause odd issues and graphical glitches
[*] Fixed a bug in which a dying Defiler wouldn’t spawn a Hellbat and instead would disappear if player stopped looking at it
[*] Fixed a bug where the C and D keybindings would instead bind to mouse buttons in certain cases
[*] Fixed a bug where an empty HUD element would appear if the player died with the Occult Mask on
[*] Fixed Priest’s coughing in Chapter 2. No more ghostly coughs after he moved on!
[*] Fixed a bug where the proper in-game cursor was lost to the Worlds Beyond. A successful expedition was mounted to retrieve the cursor from the unseen horrors.
[/list]

notes.title: Blood West v4.3.0
notes.content:
Welcome back to the weird west yet again, gunslingers and shamans alike. We've got a [b]BIG ONE[/b] for ya today. v4.3.0 brings [b]new features, music, achievements, plenty of fixes and improvements[/b] and as you no doubt can already see... we're [b]Steam Deck Verified![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/4c31e2df93b9ef4d7d88162b3e13a49a0887c092.png[/img]

Moreover, we've finally added a [b]codex[/b] to keep track of all the notes you find in the game, so you can brush up on yer readin'! (and remind yourself which monsters are weak to what)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/185309bc66b2c7ffb0e7233ff03248f13b71b898.jpg[/img]
This will also let you know how many notes you're missing, for you completionists out there.

Speaking of completion - we've added *10* new achievements for Dead Man's Promise:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/71dd22215d0fa3d07301c7eb934da6ce5ad907f6.jpg[/img]\
[i]good luck Shaman...[/i]

[*] [b]NEW MUSIC[/b] at the Safe Zones! Something to soothe players' nerves and ease their burden whenever coming back from the Barren Lands.
[*] [b]NEW ARTIFACT![/b] If the player owns every single Ace card artifact, they can now be assembled into one. The ultimate Ace hand! Just click on any Ace card and select the “use” button to let the magic do the rest:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/9050f47ad5b104f8f76a37ebb9da4c6070e68a8a.png[/img]

[i]We've also done plenty more, so read on down... there's even a surprise at the end.[/i]

[b][u]Bug fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Chapter 1 boss would become unresponsive if the player performed save & load at the start of the boss fight
[*] Fixed an issue with the Rotten Skeleton’s incorrect behavior if his soul was sold and the player simply rested in a bed. 
[*] Fixed an issue where combination of Watch and Tentacle Cyst artifacts as well as maxed out Strong Lungs trait would allow player to “skip” from place to place
[*] Fixed an issue where the Doctor in Chapter 3 would not give his sidequest
[*] Fixed an issue with Alvaro’s Rib where it would grant different boost values than expected when combined with certain artifacts, perks or consumables
[*] Fixed an issue where Hangman’s Noose kill streak would be interrupted with a headshot when using any shotgun
[*] Fixed an issue where player was able to heal themselves with the Cursed Doll weapon by using its secondary attack on dead enemies’ heads (lol)
[*] Fixed an issue where it was impossible to remove certain weapons that required “death or Purple revival” even after dying if player died while holding a different weapon in hand
[*] Fixed an issue where players would take twice as mumch damage when landing on ladders or rope
[*] Fixed an issue where regular Cultists in Dead Man’s Promise would give a lot more Soul Essence than they should
[*] Fixed an issue where status effect icons would remain on screen when loaded into a new map and a dialogue was instantly triggered
[*] Fixed an issue where Hellfire Cultist's would have a second heart as a loot even after his heart was already stolen using pickpocketing
[*] Lots of controller related issues have been fixed
[*] Few language improvements have been added as well
[/list]
[b][u]Improvements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Font size has been scaled up - this change is both for PC and Steam Deck and should make everything much easier to read. This also means Blood West is officially Steam Deck verified!
[*] Added “drop item” functionality for controllers - default bind can be changed in the Settings menu
[*] Added an option to change default metric units from meters to [b]paces[/b]. [i]For immersions sake :)[/i]
[*] Added a launch parameter “-nogamepad” on Steam - when used, it disables any non-keyboard/mouse inputs that could in specific cases cause issues. To enable it, just enter the command in the Launch Options in Blood West’s properties on Steam.
[*] Chapter 2 boss is now slightly tougher and a bit more aggressive (rawr)
[*] Lady Anabelle or The Priest will offer discounts to their wares if given the cure (mind you, this will only affect games where the player didn’t give the Cure to any of those characters yet)
[*] Purple Revival now removes Blessings as well
[*] Resolution in the Settings menu is now a proper dropdown list
[*] Improvements to the input system to better handle certain cases like when player uses AZERTY keyboard layout and changes certain keybinds
[*] Totem of Souls voice is now more “spectral” (at Gianni's request)
[*] Improvements to the quest tracking and journal entries for a few Chapter 2 quests 
[*] A slew of small SFX improvements
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West/

But wait a minute there, partner. I promised y'all a surprise, didn't I?

Well I can't let you leave before I finally confirm...

That we're working on... 

Something y'all have been asking for, for a long LONG time.

[b]You ready?[/b]

[i]Because it's comin' at ya.[/i]

[h2]NEW GAME +[/h2]

Next update.

See ya there o7

notes.content:
[h3][b]Version: 4.1.0[/b] 

[i]Patch #1 for Dead Man’s Promise and patch #6 for base game[/i] [/h3]

[quote][b]For those affected by the issue with an empty map (no enemies, no NPCs): simply rest in bed. A single rest should fix this and populate the map again! If your player character is wearing the Ring of Tahoe, unequip it before resting![/b][/quote]
[u][b]Bug fixes:
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where using [b]ALT+F4[/b] during player’s death could result in enemies and NPCs missing from map
[*] Fixed an issue where it was impossible to activate the altar at the bottom of the Mine and open portal leading to end-game
[*] Fixed cases where every ammo stack had only one bullet (including traders)
[*] Fixed a bug where Herald Talisman and Devil’s Eye buffs would reset after saving and loading a game
[*] Fixed a bug where melee attacks would not register correctly when using a staff
[*] Fixed an issue where Strix would ignore rocks being thrown at them
[*] Fixed a case where a Terror Eye could be performing ranged attacks on an entity other than the player and that attack would still affect the player
[*] Fixed a bug in which Nightmare’s SFX could stack and overlap aggressively if it couldn’t reach the player
[*] Fixed a case of cursed cave where Rotten Skeleton resides - the layout of objects inside it should no longer change 
[*] Fixed certain dialogues missing their voiceover or their VO was truncated
[*] Fixed an issue where Coffin Amulet wouldn’t always stun a Skin Collector
[*] Fixed an issue where The Untouchables values in their description were incorrect

[*] Fixed an issue where a projectile like a Tomahawk would disappear after hitting an ethereal enemy like a Spirit

[*] Shambler (the chest aka player’s stash) will no longer have its SFX overlap. Also, it will stay still when being used

[*] Saber heavy attack is now a stab (also in base game)
[*] Dead Man’s Promise’s map should load much faster now!
[*] A slew of extra SFX improvements
[*] Small update to the credits and miniscule update to texts in general
[/list]
Thank you for your patience as we worked on the first patch for Dead Man's Promise! If you've enjoyed Blood West, Dead Man's Promise and the Shaman's journey - don't forget to leave a review, Gunslinger!

notes.title: Dead Man's Promise FAQ
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome undead gunslingers and spirit talkers alike. 
Welcome to the Dead Man's Promise FAQ.[/h3]

You've got questions? [b]Well, we've got answers.[/b]

But first... here's a message from The [b]Shadow Man[/b] himself, the voice of [b]The Shaman [/b]in [i]Dead Man's Promise[/i], the one and only... [b]Redd Pepper[/b]:

[previewyoutube=_60A7O0mI4k;full][/previewyoutube]
And now, onto your most [b]Frequently Asked Questions...[/b]

[h3][b]General Questions[/b][/h3]

Q: [i]Is Dead Man’s Promise a [i]standalone[/i] expansion or is it now part in the main campaign story?[/i]

A: DMP is a standalone expansion, played separately from the main campaign. But it is launched from the main menu of Blood West. [b]It does not have its own .exe or app on Steam.[/b]

Q. [i]Do I need to own Blood West in order to play Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A. [b]YES.[/b]

[i]Q: Is it required to finish the main campaign before playing DMP?[/i]

A: No! But it is encouraged to at least finish Chapter 2 to get some good background on who you'll be playing as in Dead Man's Promise and why. Plus you'll be more prepared!

[i]Q: Can I play Dead Man's Promise with my character from the base game?[/i]

A: No. Dead Man’s Promise features a NEW character together with a NEW set of weapons and skills to use.

[i]Q: Is Dead Man's Promise a prequel or sequel to the main game?[/i]

A: It’s kind of in the middle. The Shaman's story takes place around when the player in the main campaign leaves to go to Chapter 3. [b]Think of it as a side story from Chapter 2.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/dfc1da28d2be252559a0ccc09dab012f0f208d73.jpg[/img]
[i]Q: How long will it take to beat Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A: Hard to say, but about the same as the other chapters of Blood West. Your mileage may vary!

[i]Q. How much will it cost?![/i]

A. $14.99 but existing owners of Blood West will be able to get it for $9.99 at launch :)

[i]Q: Will there be new content for the main campaign, too?[/i]

A: Together with Dead Man's Promise we will be releasing a patch with some Quality of Life Improvements and are already planning to do more in the future (along with more DLC)

[i]Q: Will this expansion release in Early Access?[/i]

A: No, it will be fully released as a proper expansion!

[i]Q: What translations/languages will be available?[/i]

A: The same as the base game, so: English, German, Polish, Hungarian and Russian

[i]Q: When will Dead Man's Promise release?![/i]

A: SOON™ (Sooner than you think)

[h3][b]The Map[/b][/h3]

[i]Q: What does the map look like? Is it the same map as the swamps from Chapter 2?[/i]

A: No! It's a brand new map - although it is also a [i]bog[/i], so it may look a bit similar at first glance...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/2eaeef82b1b10bf0b2ac40911fa26704abc5458c.png[/img]
[i]Q: How big is the map?[/i]

A: Think of it as the size of Chapter 1 but packed packed with [b]much[/b] more content!

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]

[i]Q: Will there be new traits?[/i]

A: Yes! 12 new traits await you in total to build your own version of The Shaman.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/faf291a1746459ac18f14325560eef1b3152ff3f.png[/img]
[i]Q: How many new weapons and artifacts are there in Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A: Over 40! Including [b]new [/b]weapon types.

[i]Q: How about monsters, how many [b]new[/b] dangers lurk in the swamps of Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A: 11 new enemies await, plus some old favorites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/2d5c639ecf89dd584c336a351c76162adae19c05.jpg[/img]
[i]Q: What else is [b]new[/b] in Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A: New status effects, the ability to [b]summon allies[/b] to your aid, traps and more!

[i]Q: How about lore?![/i]
 
A: Of course there will be quite a few new things to lay your weary eyes upon and maybe even some revelations on how the world of Blood West works!

[h3][b]Other Assorted Questions[/b][/h3]

[i]Q. Is Dead Man's Promise harder than Blood West?[/i]

A. Of course! Expansion packs are always harder than the base game? MUHAHAHAHAHA

[i]Q: Will there ever be a map editor or anything like that? [/i]

A: No

[i]Q: Official mod or Steam Workshop support?[/i]

A: Not right now...

[i]Q: Multiplayer? Co-op?[/i]

A: Sorry!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/6a4bf9cf2f75442d6711c4782b0548bb39eff877.png[/img]
[i]Q: Steam Deck Verification?![/i]

A: Working on it!

[i]Q. New Game+?[/i]

A. Wouldn't that be fun...

[i]Q: Roguelite Randomizer Mooncrash Style DLC?![/i]

A: Not a bad idea...

[i]Q. When should I wishlist Blood Man Dead Man's Promise?!?!?![/i]

A. [b]NOW[/b]

notes.content:
[h3][i]GUNSLINGERS…[/i][/h3]

It’s been almost a year now since [i]Blood West[/i] was released - and your response was the best reward we could have asked for.

[b]Now it’s time for a new adventure:[/b]

Meet [b]The Shaman.[/b]

[previewyoutube=Xp-i15skIA0;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Blood West: Dead Man’s Promise[/i] is a full expansion for [i]Blood West[/i] following Twen’s father as he works to pay off his debt to the [b]God of Death.[/b]

Voiced by the Shadow Man himself, the unmistakable [b]Redd Pepper.[/b]

A new protagonist, new maps, new weapons, new skills, new enemies, [i]same Blood West.[/i]

[b][h3]Wishlist NOW[/h3][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158590/Blood_West_Dead_Mans_Promise/

[b][h3]Coming SOON™[/h3][/b]

But wait… did you read that right? [b]New Blood?![/b] Oh [i]HELL[/i] yes you did.

[u][h3]The New Blood West[/h3][/u]
Seeing your engagement along initiatives such as the Creep Contest, Feedback Survey and Expansion Teaser, proved to us that there is just not enough Blood West for you yet, and we feel exactly the same. 

While looking at the possible future of the Blood West franchise, as the video game world has been shaken to its foundations, we’ve decided to significantly expand the game with new content and partner up with the one publisher we’ve always looked up to, New Blood Interactive - in order to see Blood West reach its full potential.

Hyperstrange is now closely working with New Blood together on Blood West. Meaning you can expect another layer of quality to come to barren lands, new content, fully fledged expansions like Dead Man’s Promise.

But that’s not all….

[u][h3]A Fistful of Polish[/h3][/u]
This partnership starts RIGHT NOW. The base game of Blood West has just received a patch to begin the overall vision of improving the whole game. Enjoy, gunslingers.

[b]Changes and features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved game introduction and tutorials 
[*] Improved projectile throw indicator
[*] Added a "faster way" back to the boss fight in Chapter 1

[*] Fixed a potential issue where the “hiding in bushes” modifier could be stacked
[*] Fixed a visual bug where key icons would not be displayed properly in in-game UI
[*] Fixed Emerald Eyes bonus not being active when the weapon was holstered
[*] Fixed a bug that could result in Tomahawks and other projectiles multiplying when hitting a Hellbat
[*] Fixed an issue where certain quest would not update properly when playing through Chapter 1
[*] Fixed Rose Bonbon potion regenerating HP while it was intended

Now for the second surprise. Can’t get enough of Blood West’s lore? Then keep your eye out for the new Blood West Bestiary series that will be dropping on our social media channels! Today you can hear what a certain someone, whom you have already “met” in the game has to say about the Hellbear.

Last but not least, we have the aforementioned 2.4.0 update. It is a lengthy one, so better grab something to drink.

[*] Major balance pass to everything, from enemies to items, perks and more

[*] Big optimization task has been completed and players should see an increase in fps across the board

[*] Added beds to Chapter 1 to keep it consistent with other maps and to add more options for the players regarding fast traveling (Chicken Heads are still needed, so look out for those!)

[*] LOTS of language improvements, corrected typos and other gremlins
[*] VO for Jim Hooper has been changed

[*][b] Ammunition from bags is now usable by the player - reload away![/b] No more having to open inventory, find your bag and unpack those damn bullets manually each time you wanted to reload. 
[*] Player character will lower his weapon when talking to NPCs. A bit of good manners.
[*] Lots of general audio improvements
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A number of possible crashes has been addressed
[*] At very specific circumstances, NPCs from Chapter 2 would not act according to their story route
[*] Bunch of quality of life improvements across the board ie. how double clicking to move items works in certain scenarios
[*] Fixed a case when it was possible to miss an attack when using a knife and sneaking behind an enemy

[*] Squashed a literal horde of annoying bugs.

notes.title: Blood West Chapter 3 Teaser
notes.content:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

We know you’re eagerly looking forward to our full release coming December 5th, 2023. So are we! To sweeten the waitin’ game, we’ve prepared some sneak peaks of what comes after yet another summoning of your infamous outlaw in Blood West: Chapter 3!

If you’ve yet to play our Wild West game, [b]the current Steam Stealth Fest might be a great excuse to pick up Blood West for 25% OFF[/b]... to catch up with all the menaces haunting Barren Lands and the Swamps. And prep yourself to head to the Mountains. How dangerous could they be?

[h1]What comes in Chapter 3[/h1]

[b]If you’re a greenhorn, beware as there’re spoilers ahead![/b] As you remember, our next stop will be the Mountains. They’re covered with dark forest, hiding loads of new varmints and secrets, where with each step our desperado can stumble upon a swarm of glowing-red spirits. Apart from the omnipresent trees and branches, a [b]whoppin’’ rift[/b] can be spotted, with even more enemies awaitin’ anyone daring to enter it. And once you do, the air can get a bit more… demonic. [b]A worn-out railway[/b] sprawling across the location is not to be missed, one can only wonder where it might lead. Both seem quite fitting to the mountain setting [b]unlike a circus that can be spotted[/b] in the distance. Its presence itself has a mysterious aura, as what’s even going on here. All this and more unravels before your eyes as you arrive with your newfound companion, in quite unlucky circumstances – this new level brings quite a few fresh additions to your favorite bloody lore. Being the final episode, we’ll draw a conclusion to the story of your well known dudes and dudettes, what the future holds for them is up to you, Gunslingers!

[previewyoutube=-QdWd3v7eEo;full][/previewyoutube]
Don’t be buffaloed by a dark night in the desolate woods giving you peaceful vibes, as there’s plenty of varmints rumbling around. Same as Chapter 2 did, another installment introduces a new variety of monsters! We’re keeping most of them as a surprise, but with the promised sneak-peak comes an introduction to the Demon! [b]The skittering sound of  the steps of its stilts-like legs are bloodcurdling to anyone nearby.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/d792a221e3220ad5f036c1653b401d16bae0c712.jpg[/img]

It dwells in places often shrouded in dark vapors that are detrimental to the health of the living beings. It’s known for tirelessly stalking its prey, and, in spite of its size, it cuts dirt devilishly fast. We don’t have any evidence that this slightly hunched monstrosity is an inhabitant of Hell, but we can assure you it can be hella tricky to defeat as it can discharge devastatin’ ranged attacks. Just look at these four upper limbs! Beware as in melee fight they’re capable of rippin’ you to flinders. [b]During the fight, the Demon also takes advantage of the vapors that tend to surround its lairs.[/b]

Even tho’ we throw you into the deep end with all this new spawn of monsters, you won’t go around unprepared as you’ll have plenty of chances to get some new barking irons, legendary weapons included. No matter if you’re more of a gunslinger or an archer, we have you covered with fire-new weaponry.

[previewyoutube=1Qhu6hwpvik;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready for [b]Sentence[/b], whose previous owner was a self-proclaimed judge, traveling through different villages looking for those who are dodging the law. Each blow meant yet another judgment executed. Once equipped it can’t be taken-off and for each slain foe you will recover a bit of health.

Moreover you may find[b] Spite[/b], a unique bow covered in thorns and spikes. notes.title: Blood West - Chapter 2, Hotfix 2
notes.content:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

We are loading the chamber with another round of quick fixes. These should keep these pesky bugs at bay. 

[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when fighting leeches in cultist caves.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when dynamite was about to explode in the player's hand.
[*] Fixed a potential crash that could occur when dying right before firing a projectile into an enemy.
[*] There is a new, separate tab for quest artifacts. They will no longer obstruct the inventory.
[*] Angel’s Halo is no longer sellable (the player could get locked out from the main quest by selling all available items on the map).
[*] Soul Flaws and Curses will no longer transfer between the maps.
[*] All item tooltips will now correctly state effects when effects depend on a modifier or other condition (for example Blood Bow will now calculate the damage increase correctly).
[*] Swamps Boss no longer spawns tentacles in the same spot twice.
[*] Detection Meter no longer freezes if the player remains on a ladder.
[*] Resolved an issue where some enemies could be heard even when muting audio.
[*] There is a round of new character perks available on the Swamps map.
[*] Fixed an issue where weapons could be lost when switching them right after the Canyons Boss is killed.
[*] Quest tooltips on the Swamps map now correctly wrap words.
[*] Descriptions of Owl’s Shadow and Long Jack now correctly state the duration of the effects.
[*] Deleting a save now requires confirmation.
[*] Added a backup system for saves (auto-saving during rest or after death, preserving the last three states in case a save gets corrupted).
[*] Fixed instances where Spirits didn’t deal 200% damage when Glove of Wyrdness was equipped.
[*] Resolved an issue where Giant Leech did not reduce damage taken from bleeding.
[*] Rougarou will now correctly ignore the player if Rougarou’s Tongue is equipped, even if the player engages non-Rougarou mobs.
[*] Alvaro’s Rib did not state how much Stamina it gives, now it does.
[*] Solved an issue where Corrupted Liver incorrectly gave a permanent bonus of +40 health and stamina.
[*] Death Stalkers summoned by Music Box no longer keep respawning on each loaded save.
[*] Scallywags’ Molotov now disappears from the model if it is not available in their inventory. The Scallywags’ Molotov supply for throwing is still infinite.
[*] Soul Catcher description will now correctly state how much stamina it gives.
[*] Angel’s Halo can now be stored in bags.
[*] Under some circumstances it was possible to obtain more than one blessing on Swamps.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Buffalo Rifle did not allow the player to change the ammo type after shooting.
[*] Some mouse sensitivity settings will no longer be lost after death.
[*] Yellow River will now correctly state the effect’s duration.
[*] Resolved an issue where under some circumstances, it was not possible to unequip Perforated Heart.
[*] Resolved an issue where Sack of Money got stuck in inventory.
[*] Tutorial messages will no longer trigger second time on Swamps.
[*] Death Stalker head parts use correct meshes now.
[*] Wrong notification message was displayed if the player tried to remove Corrupted Liver while drunk.
[*] NPC Idle animations will no longer be interrupted if there is no good reason for that (like talking with the player).
[*] Corrected some typos in the UI.
[/list]

[h3]That is all for today's update. Stay safe and warm, partners![/h3]

notes.title: Blood West: Chapter 2 update is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

On the 10th of February, Blood West moseyed on down to Steam Early Access. Since then, the posse of the revenant gunslinger only has grown. Currently, folks on Steam have given the game a ratin’ of 91% of positive reviews out of more than a thousand of them. The only complaint was that there ain’t enough of it… 

Tonight, on the last night of October, 2022, the dead once more come crawlin’ back from der’ graves to feast on the living with the horrifically huge update to [b]Blood West[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/f9daf6f885b8228262740e4e78490e17c6ad223c.png[/img]

This time players will have to test their grit against the swamps and their lovecraftian denizens. The new location itself is almost twice the size of the original Canyons. The new area is filled to the brim with points of interest, from old fishing towns and alligator farms to a derelict paddle steamer.

The players will also have a chance to run into an old friend as well as meet new fully voice-acted dudes and dudettes who will tell you a tale or two. Tho’ this ain’t gonna be a sightseein’ trip as cultists of cosmic horrors, zombie alligators, specters, and all other nasty varmints will be huntin’ you in these desolate lands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/334a4c96d58d0e9224789acc5b4abe9ea5c10d28.png[/img]

As in Chapter 1, it’s better to come prepared. New artifacts, potions, and weapons can be found on the swamps or purchased from those who are still breathin’. There’s even a crossbow for those who are feelin’ medieval.

To sweeten the deal, as a part of Steam Scream Sale, [b]Blood West[/b] will be available at a 25% discount till the 1st of November, till 18.00 CEST. We have even thrown in a fistful of bug fixes and optimizations for Chapter 1. That's only 24 more hours, so don't waste any time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West

Please note, that this is an Early Access update and the game is still in WIP state. There are some things still amiss in this update, and we'll be rolling out subsequent patches as they come (please refer to the release notes below), but we really wanted to make your Halloween special, rather than wait until everything is perfect!

[*] 5 new types of weapons
[*] 11 new unique weapons
[*] 25 new artefacts
[*] 3 new potions

[*] A whole lotta bug fixes

[*] Potion can wrongly stay in inventory after use if animation didn't finish
[*] Burning sfx from Molotov can stay even after respawn if player died/reloaded
[*] It is possible to die with equiped Gold Coin and still get Soul Flaw

notes.title: Blood West: Chapter 2 update is coming on October 31! + Halloween promo!
notes.content:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

This is the Season of the Dead... and Undead! Something sinister is brewing once again in the Barren Lands. Some of you may already have freed the deserted mining town of the demonic presence brought about by unspeakable deeds. But there is no rest for the wicked! You'll be summoned again, to face an even greater evil in a place even more twisted and creepy. [b]Blood West: Chapter 2 update[/b] arrives on October 31!

[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]

So, if you haven't played [b]Blood West[/b] yet, this [b]Steam Scream Fest[/b] is a great excuse to pick it up 25% OFF...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West/

...and get into the game just before it gets BIGGER. "How much BIGGER is Blood West gettin, Hyperstrange?". Glad you've asked!

[h2]What to expect from Chapter[/h2]

A bit of background, first. When [b]Blood West[/b] launched into Early Access in February, we knew we had something special, but we were still blown away by the exceptional reception of our wild west / horror stealth shooter. You folks loved it. It was the first ever Hyperstrange title to enjoy the Overwhelmingly Positive review score - and for quite a long time, for that matter.

But for all the love [b]Blood West[/b] received here, it was conceived as a side project. A smaller-scale game, that could've been developed by a smaller team alongside our smash-hit, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/url]. We've announced an Early Access roadmap that would have us releasing the second chapter in the summer, and wrapping up the project around November. A small-scale game, by a small-scale team. Seeing the audience's reaction we knew, this wouldn't be the best way to go anymore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/1c1e59d0c78ca5f24c029339f2fa670a53959e8a.png[/img]

The team working on [b]Blood West[/b] was expanded, and the gears shifted towards making the project a bit more ambitious. A single-player, cozy experience nonetheless, but with a bit more of... everything, than originally planned. So - back on topic - what you can expect of Chapter 2? 
[list]
[*] A new map that's not only larger, but more tightly packed with events and points of interest. 
[*] New weapons and items, including artifacts and unique guns. 
[*] More NPCs with more elaborate quest lines and at least four times as much dialog lines. 
[*] Brand-new monsters swarming the - much more detailed - new environment: the swamp. 
[*] Brand new mysteries to piece together while learning more about the Barren Lands and the nature of Evil. 
[/list]
All this and more to provide a proper challenge to the buffed-up, armed-to-the-teeth desperados who already completed chapter one. All of it coming your way in just a few days!

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCISION release, new games in the catalog, and more Realms Deep 2023 news from Hyperstrange
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/1699b1f20e514af85e9d00ea02a216d728938311.png[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrangers![/h1]

It is [i]that[/i] time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

[h2]INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers![/h2]
[previewyoutube=qlgqps4wcbU;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734680/INCISION/
Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

[h2]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/
POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude! 

[h2]Blood West - Chapter 2 announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West
Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

[h2]Supplice - release date announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=2YS2ZCjBTnw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: [b]30 march 2023[/b]!

[h2]77p Egg: Eggwife - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
We fell in love with Eggwife after first seeing it in the Realms Deep 2021 showcase. Now, after we've released POSTAL: Brain Damaged it's perfectly clear, that the audience wants us to take things a step further. Or a lot of steps further. To go so far, that we'll end up in UK. Eggwife is what would happen if the Brits came up with POSTAL, but... it's so much more. An immersive sim? A dating sim? A shopping cart driver sim? You name it! Maybe just go wishlist it, and get the Demo for you to plau

[h2]GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qAiV6YUVacM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/
We strive to bring overlooked, original titles to a broader audience. Sometimes originality isn't apparent at face value. What seems like an arena shooter with retro stylings happens to become a whole sprawling world full of adventure and danger. You can find out for yourself just what makes Ghostware so unique that it found its way to our hearts. We'e not sure of the release date yet with this one, but we do highly encourage you to wishlist it and take the available demo for a spin.

And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

[h2]Your's truly,[/h2]

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition (OST & Art Book bundle!) + upcoming updates!
notes.content:

[h1]Hyperstrange friends, RWS fam![/h1]

Hyperstrange-developed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/url], the action-packed DOOM Eternal-like spin-off of the POSTAL series is finally here, and  if you own any of the eligible RWS or Hyperstrange titles, or some other staple throwback-shooters like DUSK, Hedon, or Nightmare Reaper, you can get PBD with an additional discount added on top of -20% release discount [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/][b]via one of the special bundle deals[/b][/url].

Yes, Hyperstrange really pulled this one off. The game is good and the release has been relatively bug-free despite the 2-week delay made explicitly to implement some bugs and stay on-brand. But it wouldn't be a POSTAL release if something haven't gone wrong. Many of you were waiting for the release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged Official Soundtrack[/url]. The wait is finally over! The OST has arrived, and you can get it separately or bundled with the official Art Book in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26678/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged__Connoisseur_Edition][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=q7UXDk9xsaM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]UPCOMING UPDATES[/h1]

The Hyperstrange Dev team is very grateful for the amazing reception of PBD. This gives them even more motivation to improve and expand the game post-release. Here's what to expect soon:

[list]
[*] [b]Post-release fix [/b]- an update taking care of the known issues reported by the players, that slipped into the full release (ETA: One week)
[*] [b]Balancing update[/b] - some players, as well as [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ld5VPBIQeSM]some internet micro-celebrities[/url], have brought to our attention that the game offers way to much ammo if you explore the levels 'Quake-style', and far too little if you prefer to push on 'Doom Eternal-style'. The update will take care of that issue, allowing everyone to enjoy the game in their preferred playstyle. The update will also reconfigure some of the enemy positioning, spawns, and behavior. (ETA: One month)
[*] [b]New playmodes[/b] - With that taken care of, the dev team will proceed to expanding the game itself, introducing an oft-requested horde mode, as well as another playmode offering a new, and replayable PBD experience. (ETA: This summer)
[*] [b]More to be announced![/b]
[/list]

Hyperstrange and RWS are both extremely pleased with the reception of [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b]. We're as excited as you are, to see what the future will bring to this explosive and twisted spin-off.

[b]Your true friends and family,[/b]

notes.content:

[*] Fixed a bug that allowed for the ammo to be cloned under some rare circumstances 
[/list]

That's it for today, Gunslingers.
[h3]Good hunting![/h3]

notes.title: Blood West 1.1 update
notes.content:
[h2]Gunslingers![/h2]

You've been fighting relentlessly to take back the frontier from the bloody claws of otherworldly abominations for two full months. And there's thousands of you! We've been blown away by your enthusiastic reception of [b]Blood West[/b] and humbled by the [b]overwhelmingly positive reviews[/b]. You've been recommending our game to your friends and other Steam players, and it means the world to us. We know we love old-school, immersive gameplay full of stealth, tactics, and exploration - it's nice to know you do, too!
[code][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/c2bd5a54ba809f84f985a2c640692eca45d64732.png[/img]
The Skin Collector - enemy concept in the upcoming scenario[/code]

Some of you say our western stealth shooter arrived in Early Access in better form than some high-profile games left it. That's a bar set really high, for sure, and we're doing and will continue to do our best to meet your expectations. We don't yet have a set release date for the upcoming content update that will bring about the second playable scenario. Seeing how much you appreciate the fine details of our creation we want to put as much - or more - effort into crafting the next rich and varied part of the world of [b]Blood West[/b]. 
[code][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/35fe12b252288396b3d09a3981c14d22b5b8cf11.png[/img]
The Wraith - enemy concept in the upcoming scenario[/code]

While we work on the new content we also improve on some aspects of the existing game, because there's always room for improvement, and we're no strangers to early access. Today marks the release of our first regular Early Access update (full changelog below!). It'll be accompanied by a week-long promo matching the release discount of 20%, so all of you who were on the fence with Blood West in the release week and held out until there's more reviews - here's your chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West/

[h2]Full 1.1 changelog:[/h2]

Following your generous feedback and going through the many gameplay videos and streams, we've decided our priorities for the first post-release patch. Here's how we're improving on the game's mechanics and introducing some quality-of-life improvements:

[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list][*]A new, alternate bossfight path
[*]Leaning from behind cover (make sure to bind the keys!)
[*]New vendor items - sacks that improve inventory management
[*]By popular demand items in the inventory can now be rotated to improve stackability (have fun!)
[*]You can now bind the key to unload ammo
[*]FOV slider added
[*]V-Sync toggle added
[*]Brightness / gamma setting (does not affect the UI)
[*]ESC key closes inventory/map screen
[*]Trying to bind a key that's already in use will prompt an option to swap them
[*]Keybind menu cannot be closed if not all keys have been set, missing bindings will be highlighted[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]Improved enemy A.I. - they will react to gunshots in their hearing range, notice if another mob in their line of sight is killed, become alarmed in vicinity of other aggravated mobs
[*]Jim's lucky coin quest is now failable if the player chooses to keep the coin for themselves
[*]Reworked the acid-spitting Humanpede behavior - it should now be more challenging to fight, although it still prefers to avoid up-close combat
[*]Nerfed the Collector perk - it generates less loot
[*]Nerfed the Gotcha! perk - it now provides just longer, not infinite effective headshot distance
[*]Totem blessings no longer stack - you can only have one active at a time
[*]Putting a bow on the ground while it was drawn will return the arrow to the inventory
[*]Removed the Shadow Heart item
[*]Reduced healing items and ammo amount player can find in the game world
[*]Some spelling and grammar corrections (not final)[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list][*]Loading your game no longer causes FPS to drop
[*]Quitting the game by Alt+F4 combo no longer risks corrupting your save file
[*]The UI prompts display the correct bindings right away, not after game restart as it used to
[*]Ctrl and Shift keys are now bindable
[*]Reloading the boss fight no longer causes wendigo not to spawn properly
[*]Fixed the rare bug that allowed losing or multiplying bandages (and other stackable items)
[*]Fixed the breaking platform in the boss fight which was breaking to quick on subsequent tries
[*]Sliding or running downwards on slopes no longer generates damage to the player
[*]Multiple fixes to the save game functionality
[*]More clear option selection ("Accept" closes the form and saves the changes, "Back" was renamed to "Cancel", acts accordingly)
[*]Molotov burning sound no longer loops on mob impact
[*]Mobs no longer vocalize post-death (which occurred when killed with shotgun or other multi-projectile weapon)
[*]Ghosts no longer leave blood splatter on walls[/list]
[code][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/6b2935d0fc0daef6bfd9bea00a2b89c238ec6d8a.png[/img]
Sacks - a useful new addition to the player's inventory[/code]

Please note that after the patch loading an existing save game will result in the player being re-located to a safe zone, and all the monsters will be re-spawned. 

This concludes today's summary. If you have any more suggestions or happen to run into some issues, please make sure to let us know either here, in the game's Steam hub, or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/5fCZK562jT][b]Blood West channel of Hyperstrange Discord[/b][/url].

[h3]Good hunting, Gunslingers![/h3]

[h2]Next from HYPERSTRANGE[/h2]

If you enjoy [b]Blood West[/b] not just for it's stealth but also its action and visuals, you might be interested in our teams upcoming FPS - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b][/url]. That's right - The notorious [b]POSTAL[/b] series returns in a twisted spin-off that it into a whole new direction. Developed by Hyperstrange under the watchful eye of Running with Scissors, POSTAL: Brain Damaged gives you retro-FPS looks and fast-paced modern gameplay. Please consider adding it to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged

[h2]Yours truly,[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/c1f52137ea22596c7a9f0d203855c812c4a283db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/2bc33f7d62aa815b11a170c06fa81c77c83e5bc5.png[/img][/url]
